title: Demotion gate — sends a live strategy back to paper

spec.version: demotion-gate v1 (2026-11-14, pre-registered before any priced result)

stages.paper: Graded on recorded opening and closing snapshots; zero real stake.
stages.live: Real stake allowed. Only after every promotion rule passes.

promotion_rules.rule: All 10 frozen gates G1–G10 pass on the frozen holdout (nfl-command gates.json).
>= 300 graded paper selections, each with an official-source game link and a recorded closing snapshot.
Closing-line beat rate: Wilson 95% LOWER bound > 0.50 (signal).
Placebo test: observed signal above the 95th percentile of 10,000 label-shuffled runs.
Two consecutive prospective review windows with no demotion trigger.

demotion_triggers.rule: Rolling 150 live selections: closing-line beat rate Wilson 95% UPPER bound < 0.50.
Rolling 300 selections: placebo percentile < 95 (signal no longer beats luck).
Bankroll drawdown >= 15% (gates.json G9). Can demote; can never promote.
More than 2% of live selections lack a recorded closing snapshot.
More than 25% of selections made in weeks with an Out starter lack a recorded replacement-depth rank.

spec.missing_data_rule: Any missing input for a live strategy = demote. Any missing input for promotion = stay paper.
spec.current_status: No strategy has priced selections. All strategies are registered; none may be live.
